problems.name: Casio watch lacking heart rate only feature

quotes.author: busymom0
quotes.text: I wish there was a minimal Casio watch which only had heart rate tracking (with high frequency polling too).

problems.summary: Users want a simple Casio watch that tracks heart rate, but current Casio models either lack heart rate sensors or include too many extra features.

problems.name: Apple TV app for HackerTube

quotes.author: krmmalik
quotes.text: Oh how I wish there was an Apple TV app for this. I do all my YouTube browsing on an Apple TV.

problems.summary: Users want a dedicated Apple TV app to stream HackerTube content, but existing solutions rely on web browsers or unofficial apps that lack proper navigation, search, and offline support.

problems.name: Sort HackerTube videos by recency

quotes.author: mixtureoftakes
quotes.text: I wish there was a way to sort by recency, if i'm mainly interested in finding obscure gems from like last 6 to 12 months of ai and tech updates

problems.summary: Users want to view the newest HackerTube videos first, but the platform only offers default or alphabetical sorting, leaving them unable to see recent uploads.

problems.name: iOS lack of work profile for Signal

quotes.author: rendx
quotes.text: …in parallel - with separate address book and all. Works very well for Signal. I wish there was something similar for iOS. There are some tools available to make management even more straightforward, like Insular, a fork of Island:…

problems.summary: Users want to keep work and personal Signal accounts separate on iOS, but iOS doesn’t support work profiles and Signal offers no built‑in work mode, forcing them to use separate devices or workarounds.

problems.name: FaceID missing on iPhone Duo

quotes.author: kristianp
quotes.text: Why is there no FaceId? Is the camera too low-res?

problems.summary: Users want FaceID functionality on the iPhone Duo, but the device lacks the necessary hardware and software support, leaving them without a convenient biometric unlock option.

problems.name: Free decent email service

quotes.author: encrypted_bird
quotes.text: …thanks I'll check it out! --- EDIT: Ohhhhhh apparently it's paid-only. Yeah, I would pay for a decent email service, but I'm poor, so I can't afford that... Thanks, anyway!

problems.summary: People want a free email service that offers privacy, ample storage, and a clean interface, but existing free providers rely on ads, limit storage, or compromise privacy.

problems.name: Process context dump tool

quotes.author: ajasmin
quotes.text: Is there a tool in Windows that will dump all of a process context to debug these kind of things: CWD, env vars, current user, elevation, etc.

problems.summary: Developers need a reliable way to capture a process’s full context for debugging, but current utilities either lack depth, are platform‑specific, or require complex setup.

problems.name: LinkedIn support case creation error

quotes.author: rbmm
quotes.text: …many times ( as example https://youtu.be/RRIm1ReQ_6A?t=221 (t=180) ) ? And why is there no reaction to it? It's as if it's been tacitly accepted.

problems.summary: Users cannot submit support tickets due to a recurring error in LinkedIn’s case creation form, and existing workarounds are unclear or ineffective, leaving them unable to get help.

problems.name: Better text encoding scheme than Unicode

quotes.author: harpersealtako
quotes.text: …perfect text encoding scheme. Why don't we have something better than unicode? Why is there no interest in making a unicode-but-better format which solves all the problems with unicode? The reason is, unicode is sufficiently good that the…

problems.summary: Users want a more efficient, compact encoding that handles all characters, but Unicode is too large and complex.

problems.name: Pay‑per‑page AI crawler cost issue

quotes.text: …that hasn't yet been released. They could also propose content that they would pay for. Once that threshold has been reached, the content get delivered either after creation or instantly. It also goes public at that point. There will be…

problems.name: Lean framework for drug discovery

quotes.author: daemonk
quotes.text: I wish there was something like LEAN for biology. But there just isn't nearly enough data to build anything close to a good drug discovery simulator. To have a LEAN for drug discovery, we would need to simulate human physiology down to the…

problems.name: No global state API for graphics teaching

quotes.author: avaer
quotes.text: GLES isn't a bad way to teach graphics but I wish there was a middle ground between it and VK. The worst part of GL is the mysterious global state you will never understand without studying the spec. The world could use an API that's…

problems.summary: Educators need a stateless graphics API to simplify learning, but existing APIs rely on global state, causing confusion and limiting flexibility.

problems.name: Realistic virtual guitar VST

quotes.author: tuzemec
quotes.text: I would pay for this in a VST form

problems.summary: Users want a VST plugin that accurately simulates guitar playing with expressive control, but current options are either too synthetic, lack real‑time playability, or are prohibitively expensive.

problems.name: Code hosting platform with Anthropic AI

quotes.author: herpdyderp
quotes.text: …using it on day one. If they launched a GitHub competitor built around it I would pay for it on day one.

problems.summary: Developers want a GitHub‑style repository and collaboration tool that natively integrates Anthropic’s AI for code review, generation, and assistance, but current services either lack AI features or rely on other providers, leaving a gap for a unified solution.

problems.name: Desktop app for easy website creation

quotes.author: privacyishuman
quotes.text: Why is there no GUI desktop app that lets you easily make a website?

problems.summary: Users want a simple, offline-capable desktop tool to build websites quickly, but existing solutions are either web-based, overly complex, or lack robust offline functionality.

problems.name: Cheap Android TV box with free OS

quotes.author: drnick1
quotes.text: I wish there was a reasonably cheap, sufficiently powerful TV box compatible with a free distribution Android TV. Something like Graphene/Lineage for TVs. Lineage does in fact have some TV builds, but there is basically no suitable new…

problems.summary: Users want an inexpensive Android TV box that runs a free distribution, but existing devices are pricey or require paid software, leaving a gap in affordable, open‑source solutions.

problems.name: Diff viewer and vim mode in Helix-based editor

quotes.author: jswelker
quotes.text: …And even though abstractly I like helix's keyboard model better than vim, I wish there was a way to just switch to vim mode because it is too ingrained. Maybe this fork can address some of this either directly or by allowing plugins.

problems.summary: Users want a built‑in diff viewer and Vim keybindings in Helix, but Helix lacks a native diff interface and does not support Vim mode, forcing them to use external tools or workarounds.

problems.name: Run extension code in current tab

quotes.author: cobbzilla
quotes.text: …want to write a Firefox extension that runs in your open browser tab? I would pay for this.

problems.summary: Users want to execute extension scripts directly in an open browser tab, but existing solutions require separate extensions or cannot inject code into the active page.

problems.name: OLED or LCD version of Boox Go 7

quotes.author: stasomatic
quotes.text: …got the Boox for Android under the hood so that I could scan my email and RSS. I wish there was an OLED or an LCD version of the same device.

problems.summary: Users want a Boox Go 7 with an OLED or LCD display for richer color and better contrast, but current models only offer e‑ink, limiting functionality for non‑e‑ink use cases.

problems.name: Mac equivalent of quadlets for self-hosting

quotes.author: nozzlegear
quotes.text: …for my professional and hobby/self-hosting services. Super convenient, I wish there was something equivalent for my Mac (launchd files just don't cut it).

problems.summary: Users want a lightweight, native Mac tool to run and manage self-hosted services like quadlets, but existing options (Docker Desktop, Docker Compose, Homebrew services) are either too heavy, lack integration, or don't provide the same simplicity and ease of use.
